learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will learn to distinguish between quoting exact words (Direct Speech) and reporting what someone said (Indirect Speech).]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Have you ever passed a message from your teacher to your parents? 'The teacher said that I am a good student!' You were using Indirect Speech! Let's learn how to be a grammar-perfect messenger.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Direct speech is when we repeat the EXACT words someone said. We trap their exact words inside quotation marks (" ") so they can't escape!
Indirect (or Reported) speech is when we tell someone what another person said, but without using their exact words. We remove the quotation marks and usually join the sentence with the word 'that'.
examples_or_templates: She said **that she liked ice cream**.

lesson_modules.module_title: 🔄 The Rules of Changing (सर्वनाम और काल बदलना)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: When we remove the quotation marks to make it Indirect, two big things change: Pronouns (I becomes he/she) and Tenses (because the speaking happened in the past, Present tense steps back into Past tense).
examples_or_templates: Pronoun change: "**I** am happy" -> He said that **he** was happy.
Tense change: "I **am** happy" -> He said that he **was** happy.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which sentence is an example of Direct Speech?
options: She said that she was hungry.
She asked if I was hungry.
She told me she is hungry.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which word is commonly used to connect sentences in Indirect Speech?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Add the missing punctuation to make this Direct Speech: He said I love playing cricket.
subjective_practice.hint: You need a comma, and quotation marks around the exact words he spoke.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Change to Indirect Speech: Priya said, "I am painting a picture."
subjective_practice.hint: Remove the quotes. 'I' becomes 'she'. 'am painting' becomes 'was painting'.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Change to Direct Speech: My father said that he was busy.
subjective_practice.hint: Put the exact words back in quotes! My father said, "..."

activity_or_assignment.title: 🤫 The Gossip Game
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Ask a sibling or a parent a question like 'What is your favorite food?'. First, write down their answer in Direct Speech (e.g., Mom said, "I love pizza."). Then, report it to someone else in the house using Indirect Speech! (e.g., Mom said that she loved pizza.)

chapter_summary: ⭐ Direct speech uses exact words inside quotation marks (" ").
⭐ Indirect speech reports what was said without using quotes, often connecting with 'that'.
⭐ When changing Direct to Indirect, we change the Pronouns and change Present Tense verbs to Past Tense verbs.
